howto: Pick the output format — JPG, PNG or WebP.
Adjust the quality slider (quality only applies to JPG and WebP).
Drop one or more images onto the dropzone.
Watch the log as each image is converted with its new size shown.
Click Convert & download to get every converted file in a ZIP.
features: Convert between JPG, PNG and WebP
Quality control for JPG and WebP output
Batch conversion with per-file size log
ZIP export of all converted files

faq.a: JPG for photos and small files, PNG for graphics with transparency, and WebP for the best modern compression. Stock platforms typically prefer JPG unless a PNG is required.
Yes. If the source had an alpha channel, PNG conversion preserves it. Converting a JPG to PNG adds no transparency since the source has none.

faq.q: Why does quality only affect JPG and WebP?
faq.a: PNG is lossless — it has no quality setting. JPG and WebP use lossy compression where lower quality means a smaller file.
No. Conversion runs on a canvas locally in your browser.
